_comment: DoomArena3D scene — first-person, full 3D aim. Tick 0.05s for snappy combat. position_scale=1.0 because positions are in world units (meters), not pixels.
_ground_doc: Engine ground primitive (Tier 2.6r): creatures (tag) clamp to Y=0, projectiles (tag) despawn below it. Replaces what creature_bounds + projectile_floor_despawn rules used to do — engine-level instead of content-level. mesh{} drives the visual floor plane built by GroundRenderer.
_lighting_doc: Static sci-fi look — red horizon, warm-tinted sun, no day/night cycle (no world_clock so LightingDirector's time-of-day resolver falls back to noon=12). All color_day == color_night so the visual is constant regardless. Replaces the hardcoded Sun + WorldEnvironment nodes that used to live in doomarena3d.tscn.
_comment_tick: tick_seconds=0.05 (20Hz) — corridor shooter with WASD + hitscan. 50ms input latency acceptable (genre is exploration, not twitch). Halves rule-firing overhead vs 60Hz on the larger entity counts (projectiles, enemies, blocks_motion bodies). Per CLAUDE.md § Tick rate is the engine's heartbeat, this is a deliberate per-game override of the 60Hz default.
